# Mountain Warehouse

> > Mountain Warehouse is a UK-based outdoor retailer specializing in affordable outdoor clothing, camping equipment, and adventure gear for men, women, and children.

Mountain Warehouse offers a comprehensive range of outdoor products including waterproof jackets, fleeces, walking boots, ski wear, and camping equipment. The site features extensive clearance sections across all categories, making outdoor gear accessible with products like the Raso Fleece, Montana Half-Zip, and kids' thermal accessories.
